changes: One file traversal computes both all-pairing storage and owner workspace totals. Reservations, free-space checks and authority checks remain fresh.
Window package identity reads do not prefetch descendants. Runtime authorization is not cached or relaxed.
Hex encoding avoids repeated formatting without changing grant or revoke identity bytes.
ping exposes only the current claim latest file command duration/count metadata; no path, payload or transfer identity.

synthetic_profile.scope: Same host Java fixture of 24 workspace files and one upload; not phone latency.

privacy: Synthetic metadata only; no private phone content, identities, credentials or endpoints.
